# Privilege and handling checklist

Placeholders are illustrative. Rules named below are questions to verify at a primary source for the jurisdiction (K3), not statements of law.

## Classification guide

| Class | Question to answer | Default handling until resolved | Who decides |
|---|---|---|---|
| Privileged communication | Was it between client and counsel, for legal advice, kept in confidence? | Do not transmit; limit access | Qualified reviewer |
| Work product | Was it prepared for litigation by or for a party or its representative? | Limit access; label as work product | Qualified reviewer |
| Public record | Is it filed or published with no restriction? | Handle normally; omit unneeded sensitive data (D3) | Owner |
| Discovery | Does a protective order or agreement limit use? | Follow the order or agreement | Owner, court |
| Medical, juvenile, or other sensitive record | Does a statute or order restrict disclosure? | Restricted; redact before any sharing | Owner, qualified reviewer |
| Settlement communication | Does a rule limit its use or disclosure? | Verify the rule before relying on or sharing it | Qualified reviewer |
| Court filing | Is it sealed, or does a rule require redaction? | Check status on the docket | Owner |
| Sealed or protected material | Is there a sealing order or protection? | Do not transmit; confirm the scope of the order | Court |
| Third-party data | Does it identify someone who is not a party? | Minimize; redact | Owner |
| Unknown | Status cannot be determined | Treat as restricted; ask | Owner |

## Transmission check

| Action planned | What is sent | To whom | Class of material | Authorization record (reference) | Hook result | Decision (send, hold, ask) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Sending case material to a person or storage service needs an authorization record. A hook denial is binding: report it and answer its verification questions.

## Role boundary check

- Is the output addressed to someone entitled to legal advice from this tool? If not, label it work product for a qualified reviewer.
- Is the output a filing? If not, apply the Playbook's status label where the matter uses it.

## Handling options

Redaction, sealing, protective order, restricted access, limited-use handling, or hold pending a decision. Name the option and the person who decides.

## Items for a qualified reviewer

List every privilege, waiver, conflict, or filing-readiness question this review cannot settle.
